## Diger (CR 2)

**XP** 600  
 N Large ooze  

**Init** +0; **Senses** blindsight 60 ft.; Perception –5  

**Defense**

 **AC** 14, touch 9, flat-footed 14 (+5 natural, –1 size)  

**hp** 42 (3d8+18);  

**Fort** +7; **Ref** +1; Will—4  

**Defensive Abilities** transparent; **Immune** ooze traits  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 5 ft., fly 30 ft (poor), swim 40 ft.  

**Melee** slam +3 (1d4+3 plus 1d4 acid plus paralysis)  

**Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 5 ft.  

**Special Attacks** engulf (DC 17, 1d4 acid and paralysis), paralysis (1d6 rounds, DC 17)  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 15, **Dex** 10, **Con** 23, Int—, **Wis** 1, **Cha** 1  

**Base Atk** +2; **CMB** +5; **CMD** 15 (can’t be tripped)  

**Skills** Fly –6, Stealth +4, Swim +10; **Racial Modifiers** +8 Stealth  

**SQ** limited flight  

**Special Abilities**

 **Limited Flight (Ex)** By releasing naturally occurring helium from its body, a diger is able to fly for a number of rounds equal to 1 + 1/2 its current Constitution score (12 rounds for the average diger). After that, it must land and cannot fly again until it has rested for 2 minutes (20 rounds).  
 **Transparent (Ex)** A diger is transparent in water. It takes a successful DC 15 Perception check to recognize a motionless diger for what it really is.  

  

**Ecology**

 **Environment** underground  

 **Organization**  solitary  

 **Treasure**  none
